title: Typewriter
description: Liner notes on a 1960s typebar typewriter, seen close from above the platen. Every key swings its typebar into the ribbon and bites the cream bond with its own worn, uneven ink; Return throws the carriage home and rolls the platen.
intent: One machine finished to the edge: real strikes on real paper, where every letter lands a little differently because the typeface is worn, and the carriage moves with the weight of a steel frame.
